name: BitStrat Holdings Limited
summary: Bitstrat Holdings Ltd. operates as an investment firm, specializing in delivering outbound telemarketing and contact center services. The company's core business involves promoting a variety of financial products, such as insurance policies, credit cards, personal loans, and balance transfers, primarily for banks and insurance providers. Co-founded by Loke Yan Sun and Sui Fui Tan on December 19, 2007, Bitstrat Holdings is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
